source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Judges 1–5 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 145 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Preserve divine selling, the two men’s different roles and both locations.
Keep the exact weapon count and oppression period, identifying the ruling power without removing harm.
Keep Deborah’s sex, prophetic role, marriage designation and judicial agency; note the alternative sense of Lappidoth.
Preserve her firm assent, loss of honor, selling and the specific woman without naming Jael prematurely.
Keep Hobab and the kinship designation as given, reading-tradition Zaanannim and the narrative aside.
Keep divine panic and sword warfare together, followed by the commander’s flight.
Preserve the pursuit endpoint and exhaustive killing claim.
Keep Jael’s identity and the political relationship explaining Sisera’s refuge.
Keep the instruction to deny his presence as Sisera’s speech.
Keep Jael as agent, the implements, the bodily wound, sleep and death without importing the song’s posture.
Keep God as agent and Jabin as the separate royal opponent.
Retain the increasingly heavy hand and final destruction without inventing a specific death scene.
